svg.aria-label: I2AS information flow: readings rise from instruments through virtual instruments, the Station and the Orchestrator to the GUI and the agent gateway; every action from any client is one Command answered by one Verdict through the single writer; agents are admitted by a role ladder that exposes authority gradually.

g.text: I2AS — readings flow up, actions flow down, one contract in between
Claude Code or any MCP host
L6 · Session layer — two clients, one identity each
Agent gateway — Actor(kind=agent, id, role) · authorize() · agent feed
refused here = BLOCKED_ROLE verdict; the engine never sees it
Control contract — Command ↓ · Verdict ↑ · Event ↑ · every message names its Actor
Frozen JSON-safe dataclasses. Thread bridge: everything below runs on the one instrument thread.
Human and agent are judged by the same engine rules and seen on the same stream.
Verdict · Event, queued one hop later
One cooperative tick on one thread. Every action from every client enters through submit().
Checks the kill switch, attendance, run ownership and the session envelope; answers with a Verdict.
Runs Procedures (L4, hardware-blind) and writes each run to HDF5 through the DataManager (L5).
L2 · Station — registry of every Virtual Instrument
Polls each VI every tick; dispatches ramps and plan steps with scope and limits checked.
Builds StationInfo: what each instrument reads, what it can do, within which bounds, in which class.
get_state() of every VI, each tick
L1 · Virtual Instruments — where everything is declared, once
L0 · Drivers and physical instruments — leaves that know nothing above them
Lakeshore 335 · Keithley 6221 / 2182A · Oxford IPS120 · camera · XY stage, over VISA or serial.
A simulated twin of each one, so the whole stack runs and is tested without a cryostat in the room.
No action is written twice. Two
neither client can offer an action
the other cannot see, and one door,
• A Verdict for every Command, on
trail, kept in the experiment folder
• One HDF5 file per run, read by the
analysis worker in its own process
queued in an Outbox, published opt-in
months later, from the folder alone
An agent declares a role. One table says
which action classes that role may take.
Each rung adds one class, never a branch.
• The kill switch: read_only, then revoked;
set by the human, enforced twice
• Run ownership: abort only your own run,
or declare a takeover with a reason
Emergency standby: every role, every state,
every kill-switch setting. Whoever sees a
problem can make the station safe.
• Below the contract band: one instrument
thread owns drivers, VIs, Station, engine
• Above it: the GUI thread — mirror,
the engine through the contract only,
or reads a file the engine mirrored
Import contracts, checked in CI, keep
each layer blind to the ones above it:
drivers know no VI, VIs no Station,
procedures no hardware, the GUI no
driver, the engine no session layer.
information up: readings, snapshots, verdicts, events
actions down: one Command per action, one Verdict back
